intro: In the Northshire Vineyards, Milly's grapes lie abandoned after the Defias arrive. Crates and buckets of fruit remain at risk of theft or being crushed beneath the abbey guards' boots.

p: Milly Osworth gathers grapes in the Northshire Vineyards, where the harvest matters to local vintners and the abbey community. When armed brigands in red masks push into the fields, Milly flees to the abbey grounds. Her fresh-picked grapes remain scattered between the rows.

Stormwind guards watch the valley entrance, but too few soldiers leave Northshire vulnerable. The garrison promises to drive out the Defias, while Milly fears a drawn-out fight between guards and thieves will ruin her harvest. The crates may be trampled or carried off as provisions, costing Northshire one of its few peaceful harvests.
